topic: The Magic of Text-to-Image AI: Diffusion, CLIP, and the Math Behind the Art
target_audience: University students with a basic background in linear algebra and probability.

sections.title: Introduction: The Creative Loop (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: AI converts text prompts into visual art.
CLIP acts as our understanding engine.
Diffusion serves as our creation engine.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Latent Space (0:45-1:30)
lecture_lines: Computers see images as high-dimensional vectors.
Latent space is a map of concepts.
Similar concepts cluster together in space.
animations: Show a 2D plane with points clustered in #00FFFF, represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].

sections.title: CLIP: The Bridge Between Words and Vision (1:30-2:30)
lecture_lines: CLIP aligns text and image vectors.
It uses dot products for similarity.
High scores indicate a perfect match.
The text vector rotates toward alignment.
Math guides the semantic understanding process.
animations: Display a Text icon in #FF4500 and an Image icon in #00FF00.
Show a bridge icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bridge.svg] connecting Text and Image.
Highlight the bridge [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bridge.svg] in #FFFF00 to represent CLIP integration.

sections.title: Diffusion: The Mathematics of Noise and Recovery (2:30-4:15)
lecture_lines: Forward process adds noise to images.
Reverse process learns to remove noise.
The model predicts the original data.
animations: Reverse the animation showing noise becoming [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/image.svg].

sections.title: The Synthesis & Conclusion (4:15-5:00)
lecture_lines: CLIP provides the target semantic goal.
Diffusion iterates to refine the image.
Emergent art arises from structured math.
animations: Display the three previous concepts converging into one.
